derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical projection of referents to crm:, billing:, registry:, and contract: identifier strings; no unresolved disposition.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One identifier tuple per compiled referent in the four source families.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Fixed SQL mapping from each admitted referent to its namespace-prefixed source-native string.
derivations.required_premise: Admitted mechanical records exist for invoices, CRM accounts, registry entities, and contracts.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Boolean literal comparison on invoice_record.status; no semantic judgment.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every invoice_record receives exactly one is_open tuple.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_record.status is grounded in billing sources.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Temporal mechanical derivation; contracts without explicit expiry evidence default to not expired.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every contract_record receives exactly one is_expired tuple using compile reference date 2025-09-02.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Parse expiry/end-date term_kind rows; mark expired only when grounded date precedes reference date or source states non-renewal/expiry.
derivations.required_premise: contract_term_stated excerpts for expiry or end-date are admitted.
derivations.blocking_unresolved_state: None; absence of expiry evidence is treated as not expired, not unresolved.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical pair generation only; does not assert same-entity or distinct.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Pairs required to connect each commercially relevant CRM account to billed names, governing contracts, and registry name/VAT candidates per Purpose B connectivity policy.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Emit directed left/right pairs in source_native_identifier form following shared VAT, normalized registry name, CRM-to-billing thread, and contract-counterparty threading rules.
derivations.required_premise: Commercially relevant CRM accounts and their billing, contract, and registry threads are compiled.
derivations.optional_enrichment: commercial_notes references may justify additional pairs but are not required for candidate emission.
derivations.non_blocking_unresolved_state: Pairs may exist even when downstream identity_judgment remains UNRESOLVED.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical candidate pairing without asserting invoice governance.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One candidate per invoice paired with each contract reachable through CRM/billing commercial thread or explicit note linkage.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Cross invoice billed names with contracts linked through identity candidate paths and authoritative commercial threads.
derivations.optional_enrichment: Resolved identity_judgment may narrow candidate interpretation but is not required to emit candidates.
derivations.non_blocking_unresolved_state: Mechanical name mismatch (e.g. Oakfield Logistik vs Logistics) omits pairs without blocking other candidates.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Project admitted identity_judgment dispositions onto required candidate pairs; missing judgment defaults to UNRESOLVED; DISTINCT is permitted but none were admitted in this world.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every identity_judgment_candidate appears in purpose_ir/b/output.json with epistemic SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Join candidates to judgments; map disposition through contracts/purpose_b.json disposition_mapping; sort by left then right.
derivations.required_premise: identity_judgment_candidate enumerates the required connectivity pairs.
derivations.optional_enrichment: registry_legal_name_normalized supports mechanical equivalence reasoning already reflected in admitted judgments.
derivations.blocking_unresolved_state: None; UNRESOLVED links are emitted, not suppressed.
derivations.non_blocking_unresolved_state: UNRESOLVED identity does not block link emission; absence of SAME_ENTITY is not treated as DISTINCT.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose-scoped inclusion filter plus association disposition from billing-to-contract identity; unresolved association is explicit and non-exclusionary.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Include every invoice with a link candidate to an active contract bearing at least one acquisition-relevant clause_kind marked PRESENT.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Filter candidates where contract_is_expired=0 and acquisition clause PRESENT; copy invoice fields verbatim; set association from identity_judgment billing:{billed_name} vs contract:{contract_id} via purpose_a disposition_mapping (SAME_ENTITY->asserted, else unresolved).
derivations.required_premise: invoice_contract_link_candidate connects invoice to governing contract candidate; clause_presence_judgment marks at least one allowed acquisition kind PRESENT; contract is not expired.
derivations.optional_enrichment: invoice_contract_link_judgment LINKED may corroborate governance but does not override identity-based association mapping.
derivations.blocking_unresolved_state: clause_presence_judgment UNRESOLVED on all acquisition kinds blocks row inclusion for that contract-invoice path.
derivations.non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED yields association unresolved but row still included when inclusion filters pass; invoice_contract_link_judgment UNRESOLVED does not suppress the row.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose-scoped dependency assessment; unresolved identity forces status unresolved rather than dependent=false.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Emit one row per non-expired contract with at least one obligation_kind in {exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term} marked PRESENT; include unresolved rows when identity blocks assessment.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each qualifying contract, collect PRESENT obligation_kinds; gather open_invoice_ids from link candidates or matching billed_name when no candidate exists; status dependent only when current relationship holds and billing-to-contract identity is SAME_ENTITY; otherwise unresolved.
derivations.required_premise: Non-expired contract with at least one PRESENT obligation_kind; current relationship via open invoice or auto_renewal/rolling_term on active contract.
derivations.optional_enrichment: invoice_contract_link_judgment LINKED and CRM threads enrich open-invoice association but are not required premises for row emission.
derivations.blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED or absent on billing:{billed_name} vs contract:{contract_id} blocks status=dependent.
derivations.non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity UNRESOLVED still emits row with status unresolved; expired contract excludes row entirely; ABSENT obligation kinds exclude that kind from obligation_kinds list only.

limitations: purpose_b_reconciliation_link is a Purpose IR projection; it is not persisted in 06_world/world.sqlite.
No DISTINCT identity judgments were admitted; Purpose B output contains only SAME_ENTITY and UNRESOLVED epistemic values.
Oakfield billing-to-contract pairs were not mechanically generated (Logistik vs Logistics); Purpose C uses billed_name fallback for counterparty and open_invoice_ids on MSA-OAK-2018.
invoice_contract_link_judgment uses LINKED/UNRESOLVED only; negative linkage is not modeled.
